subject: BrightHealth: SSO/SCIM/RBAC control matrix and evidence request
messages:
From: Sara Wilson <sara.wilson@brighthealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightHealth Security <security@brighthealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -0500
Subject: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts for SIG review

Hi Rishi,

We are preparing our SIG questionnaire response and need to validate Redwood's access controls for our internal audit. Could you please provide the following artifacts and short notes describing how each control is enforced?

- SSO/SAML config export (IdP metadata, ACS URLs, SAML attribute mapping)
- SCIM provisioning logs for the last 30 days (map of external IDs to internal user IDs)
- RBAC policy snapshot (roles, privileges, example role bindings)
- A control matrix that maps SIG/SOC2 access-control requirements to Redwood evidence (who enforces, where logs live, retention)

If possible, we would like an initial package by Monday 23 Nov so our InfoSec can review before our SIG submission. We can accept sanitized logs if necessary. Also let us know the contact for follow-ups.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Wilson
Sr. InfoSec Analyst, BrightHealth
[sara.wilson@brighthealth.com]

Attachment: requested_controls_checklist.pdf (stub)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Sara Wilson <sara.wilson@brighthealth.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts for SIG review

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble everything you asked for. Quick clarifying questions so we package it appropriately:

1) For SCIM logs, do you prefer full provisioning events or a condensed CSV that maps external_id -> internal_user_id with timestamps? We can provide both but full logs are larger and will be sanitized.
2) For RBAC snapshot, do you want a machine-readable export (CSV/JSON) or a human-readable role matrix? We can include both.
3) Any constraints on where we place the artifacts (we can share a secured Drive link or upload via your portal if you prefer)?

Plan: I'll coordinate with Dev to pull exported configs and logs and with Laura to assemble the control matrix mapping to SIG/SOC2 clauses. We expect an initial bundle by COB Mon 23 Nov.

Contact for follow-ups: dev_patel@redwood.ai (technical), laura_bennett@redwood.ai (compliance mapping).

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance (APAC)
Redwood Inference
[rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai]

Attachment: request_acknowledgement.txt (stub)
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: BrightHealth evidence collection plan

Rishi / Laura — running through the extraction steps I suggest: 

- SSO/SAML: export current SP metadata and SAML attribute mapping from the SSO admin UI (ok to include IdP metadata from BrightHealth if provided). I'll scrub any session IDs before export.
  Attachment: redwood_sso_config_export-20261123.json (contains SAML endpoints, attribute map; no user PII)

- SCIM: pull provisioning events from the SCIM service for 2026-10-24 -> 2026-11-23 inclusive. We'll redact email-localparts and IP addresses for the shared package; include a mapping CSV that preserves internal user GUIDs and provisioning timestamps for traceability.
  Attachment: scim_provisioning_log-20261122.zip (sanitized logs), scim_mapping-20261122.csv (userGUID -> externalID)

- RBAC: export role definitions and role bindings as CSV; include a short README explaining roles (engineer, admin, infra, read-only). We'll also attach a CSV of sample role assignments (non-sensitive).
  Attachment: rbac_policy_snapshot-20261122.csv

- Control matrix: Laura will map each SIG/SOC2 access-control clause to the artifact and indicate control owner + retention location.
  Attachment: ctrl_matrix_v3-20261123.xlsx

Notes/asks:
- We should avoid sending raw auth logs or full session traces. If BrightHealth insists, we'll provide sanitized extracts under an NDA amendment.
- Confirm the Drive sharing permissions: link will be restricted to their security team only.

I will start packaging now; ETA for upload to a secure Drive folder is 2026-11-23 18:00 PST.

—Dev Patel
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
